CPR's stranging opening is unrelated to 8.bit.  He was trying to
send a CHAOS LSN packet, which is CHA:.foo  where foo is the
contact name.  I think we did get around that (somehow), but
8.bit looks like it needs a lisp wizard to go down inside OPEN
and do the right thing.
